Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We're getting close to our internal audit window and would like to schedule a focused technical deep-dive to review SOC 2 evidence (encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs, retention, SSO/SAML configuration and user lifecycle). Ideally we want a 60–75 minute session with space for Q&A and a brief artifacts handoff.

Can you confirm who from Redwood you recommend on the call (security, infra, CS) and share a short list of the artifacts you can make available in advance? Our auditor will want:
- sample audit logs (redacted) showing authentication and admin activity
- encryption key management overview (KMS / HSM)

- retention and deletion policy excerpts

Available windows for our security team next week: Tue 7/21 9–11am PDT, Wed 7/22 1–4pm PDT. If those don't work, please propose alternatives.

Thanks,
